items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I used to go over to his house, and he'd show me everything about reading. That's how I learned how to read, from Jack.

ctx.x: No, I didn't. I took up a course there with Marie Little, when she took over the thing on a band, in music arranging and public school music and all that stuff. But most of it I had already learned, 'cause Jack Washington was a graduate of Western University.
